% E2E canonical fixture #2 — paragraph.
% Multi-line paragraph wrapping on one page, no forced eject.
% Pins the line-breaker + interline (baselineskip) glue + parskip:
% the paragraph wraps to several lines whose baselines stack at a
% constant baselineskip, and the page stays single.
%
% NOTE: \hsize is the default plain-TeX 6.5in here on purpose: this fixture
% pins the wider-column path, and paragraph_narrow.tex pins the same body
% at 3in.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The quick brown fox jumps
over the lazy dog. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my
box with five dozen liquor jugs.
\par
\bye
